tei:div.tei:p: lo chen thams cad mkhyen pa shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa/............ (1) gtsang stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar kha skong yid ches gser gyi ljon pa/.............. (53) sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer gyi rnam thar/...... (64) mkhan po rin po che seng ge mtshan can gyi rnam thar/....... (106) yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bstod pa/..................... (145) rje btsun sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs*/ ............ (154) sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bstod pa/................. (158) rje btsun blo bzang grags pa'i ngang tshul cung zad brjod pa/.... (161) rje seng ge mtshan can la bka' gdams bu chos kyi sgo nas bstod pa/....................... (164) chos skyong spyi'i bskang bshags gur mgon zhal dang bcas pa'i bstod pa/.................... (168) dpal ldan tshogs gnyis ma/............... (173) rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ ............ (175) sher snying gi bsdus don/................. (180) chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi rnam bshad/......... (182) tshe dpag med kyi dbang chog bskyed rdzogs/.......... (197) sman lha'i rnam gzhag cho ga nyams len bde 'jug........ (213) rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi gtor chen dngos grub rgya mtsho/..... (238) gshin po rjes 'dzin sgrib pa kun sbyong*/............ (257) paṇa chen shes rin pas mdzad pa'i rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku yi phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba/...... (302) rten gsum bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa'i sgrub tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/.................... (317) bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang gi lhan thabs/..... (400) gso dpyad nyer mkho gces bsdus/
